controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Gaia's spectrum of the star. The disc is unresolved; its darker edge is half measured from transits of its planet.
controls.notes: The colour of Gaia DR3's measured spectrum of WASP-39. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
